title: Create crafting recipe additions
description: This datapack adds many custom recipes for the Create mod to automate many resources that aren't possible to automate in the base Create mod and adds balanced recipes for a few other mods like AE2 and Immersive Engineering to automate the resources too.
body:
This datapack adds many custom recipes for the Create mod to automate many resources that aren't possible to automate in the base Create mod and adds balanced recipes for a few other mods like AE2 and Immersive Engineering to automate the resources too.

Recipes:


Crushing:
Granite 1 --> Red Sand 1, Uranium Nugget (5%)
Magma block 1 --> Blaze Powder 1 (10%), Netherite Scrap (0,001%)
Basalt 1 --> Gravel 4, Nickel Nugget 2 (3%)
Limestone 1 --> Gravel 1, Redstone (2%), Silver Nugget ×4 (4%)
Sand 1 --> Copper Nugget 1 (10%)
Crying Obsidian 1 --> Lapis Lazuli (10%), Amethyst Shard (2%)
Blackstone--> Gold Nugget (16%)
End Stone 1 --> Sand (80%), Ender Pearl (1%)
Prismarine 1 --> Prismarine Shard 2, Prismarine Crystals 2 (80%), Emerald (5%)
Dark Prismarine 1 --> Prismarine Shard 2, Prismarine Crystals 1(80%), Prismarine Crystals (80%), Ghast Tear (5%), Lead Nugget 2 (20%)250ScoriaZinc Nugget (10%), Lapis Lazuli (20%)

Andeside 1 + Iron Nugget 1 --> Andesite Alloy 2
Andesite 1 + Zinc Nugget 1 --> Andesite Alloy 2
Zinc Nugget 10 + Cobblestone 6 + Lava 250mb --> Asurine 4

Cobblestone 16 + Lava 10mb --> Cobbled Deepslate 16

Charcoal 1 + Dried Kelp 2 --> Ink Sac 2
Cobblestone 1 + Water 100mb --> Limestone

Iron Nugget 10 + Cobblestone 6 + Lava 250mb --> Crimsite 4
Lava 1000mb + Netherite Scrap 2 + Gold Ingot 2 --> Netherite Ingot
Cobbled Deepslate 1 + Lava 10mb --> Netherrack 1
Gold Nugget 10 + Cobblestone 6 + Lava 250mb --> Ochrum 4 
Tuff 2 + Lava 10mb + Water 10mb --> Pointed Dripstone 2
Lava 10mb --> Sulfur Dust 1
Cobblestone 1 + Water 10mb + Lava 10mb --> Tuff
Copper Nugget 10 + Cobblestone 6 + Lava 250mb --> Veridium 4


Splashing/Filling/Haunting
Magma Block --> Obsidian
Rose Quartz --> Polished Rose Quartz

Obsidian --> Crying Obsidian
